events.title: Demo out now!

events.summary: Hey everybody :)We're very happy to announce that we've got a demo ready for Castle Away! We'll get it into your hands in a few days, so get ready to design your own flying castle! We'll explain everything that's in the demo and what else we've been working on in our next update here on Steam.Thanks for following along!René, Sim, Matthijs & Tom

events.title: Castle Away just announced!
events.summary: Hey all!We’re excited to finally announce Castle Away! Playtest signups are now open for members of the Renegade Games Discord, and we can’t wait for you to get your first look.The trailer and screenshots should give you a sense of the core gameplay loop: explore → battle → expand. There’s still plenty ahead of us in terms of content, though.The current build includes about a third of the content we’re planning for the full release.
